opening.argument: The speaker presents BitConnect as a way to lend Bitcoin to a platform in exchange for BitConnect Coin, requiring a $100 minimum and advertising average daily interest of 0.9% to 1%. The terms include capital locked for 299 days while interest is credited daily, making this a concrete financial participation offer rather than general commentary. Viewers are directed to a referral link to sign up, and the speaker promotes a five percent commission whenever referred users make loans, lend out funds, or reinvest. The video therefore combines promised lending returns with an incentive to recruit participants into the same financial arrangement.
